## Business
KAH Laban is a dessert shop in Colombo, Sri Lanka serving authentic
Middle Eastern-inspired desserts and Dubai-style kunafa, made fresh daily
using traditional Egyptian recipes.

## What we sell
- Dubai Special: Dubai Kunafa Melt (pistachio-chocolate kunafa),
  Dubai Pista Rocket (pistachio cream kunafa pastry)
- Chocolate: Choco Flakes, Choco Spread Cake, Ferrero Rocher cups,
  Oreo Delight, Pista Choco Swirl
- Caramel and Biscoff: Biscoff Crunch, Caramel Crunch, Caramel Flakes
- Fruity and Cheesy: Cheesy Mango Blast, Cheesy Strawberry Blast,
  Mango Melt Cup

## Location
Colombo, Sri Lanka. Delivery across Colombo; pickup available.
